summary: Model-authored DEK is parsed then discarded; public dek re-derived from raw markdown first sentence (leaks #/**, splits decimals)
description: blog-generate.ts parseGenerated returns {title,dek,body} but generateDraft destructures only {title,body}; the model-authored DEK: line is stripped from body and discarded. No dek column exists (migration 013). blog-public.ts dekFromContent re-derives a dek from the first sentence of raw markdown -> leaks leading #/** tokens, splits on decimals/abbreviations (e.g. 'Plotinus 4.8'), dumps whole 200-char paragraph when no terminal punctuation. Fix: persist the parsed dek (add nullable dek column + store on generate + read in blog-public, falling back to dekFromContent for legacy rows). Add tests.

resolution.note: Added nullable dek column; store model DEK on generate; blog-public reads it with first-sentence fallback for legacy rows.
